tools.name: validate_payout_beneficiary
tools.description: Check a payout beneficiary's tax ID and bank account (or PIX key) for Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia or Uruguay before sending money. Validates format, check digits and bank code against central-bank directories. Returns verdict ready | review | invalid with error codes and bank name. MX

tools.name: validate_payout_batch
tools.description: Validate up to 100 beneficiaries in one call (payroll runs, supplier files, marketplace withdrawals). Each item takes the same fields as validate_payout_beneficiary. Returns a summary count per verdict and per-item results.

tools.name: report_payout_outcome
tools.description: After sending a payout that was checked with validate_payout_beneficiary, report whether it was paid or bounced. Improves future checks.
